nodes.description: External view function valuation(address,uint256) that unconditionally returns 0, ignoring all of its inputs.
First parameter pair_ (address) of valuation; unused in the function body.
Second parameter amount_ (uint) of valuation; unused in the function body.

edges.reason: The address parameter pair_ is supplied by the caller into valuation; it flows into the function signature but never affects the returned value.
The uint parameter amount_ is supplied by the caller into valuation; it flows into the function signature but never affects the returned value.

normalization_plan.reason: pair_ is a non-core parameter of valuation with no independent dataflow or state effects; it is only used to define the function interface, so it is normalized into its parent function.
amount_ is a non-core parameter of valuation that is entirely ignored by the implementation; it carries no state or unsafe operation relations and is normalized into its parent function.
